name: KIC 2019258
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 17.7 solar radii and 1.54 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2019258 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 17.6882 +/- 0.3318

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2019258 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.542 +/- 0.0649

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2019258 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4402.593 +/- 39.5238

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2019258 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.1222 +/- 0.0041

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.54 solar masses and 17.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,403 K at its surface.
